scope: Read-only official source/type research and checkpoint ZIP inspection; no EasyEDA native/API/UI calls or global/shared library changes.

official_types.version_limit: This is an official published declaration package, not proof that every method behaves identically in the installed EasyEDA 3.2.206 runtime.

library_alias_evidence.alias_literal_mappings_in_dts: No declared literal mapping of project alias to actual current project UUID was found.
library_alias_evidence.conclusion: Use the runtime getter's returned value for documented project scope. Actual project UUID and alias equivalence is not documented; replacing one with the other for create/copy would be a pilot hypothesis, not an established correction. Existing historical symbol/footprint scripts using the actual project UUID do not prove 3D import support.

model_apis.fact: Accepts libraryUuid:string and Blob. Offline remarks at2970 describe organizing into a local model-directory library; no project-alias writable-target guarantee.

Accepts source model UUID/source library UUID/target library UUID; returns a new target model UUID. Duplicate target model name fails. Generic target signature does not explicitly confirm project alias or actual project UUID targets.
Returns ILIB_3DModelItem metadata only. No STEP/OBJ/blob/source URL binary payload is part of this interface.
Public STEP/OBJ board export with Component Model selection and autoGenerateModels=false; captures resolved geometry as an export, not editable source-model embedding.
Public full project checkpoint export; binary model inclusion is not promised by the declaration.
Public elibz/elibz2 library export. No 3D-payload inclusion option or guarantee is documented.
Public elibz/elibz2 footprint export. Instance-only 3D overrides should not be assumed present in the footprint master export.

unsupported_shortcuts: No public get3DModelSourceFile/get3DModelBinary method is present in the declared model class.
IPCB_PrimitiveComponent constructor has a model3D parameter at18987 but is marked @internal; it is not a supported way to replace an existing routed component.
No native model record or SQL payload should be fabricated from the sparse public doctype16 reference.
No copy/create retry with an alternate target scope should be described as proven correct without a controlled result and readback.

runtime_pilot_verified.unit_conclusion: Saved native UI pilot resolves distances as mil for this installed runtime: 39.37mil = 1mm, 19.685mil = 0.5mm.
runtime_pilot_verified.reference_conclusion: Saved value is qualified modelUuid|sourceLibraryUuid, not an unqualified UUID. Updating the local PCB instance does not itself modify the system model.

checkpoint_audit.changed_record: C1 COMPONENT adds only three 3D attributes. Position/angle/layer/lock/other attributes unchanged.
checkpoint_audit.additional_logical_record: One default empty NET record in C1 footprint e2e3d06dac58c326; netType/specialColor/differentialName/equalLengthGroupName null, retLine=true, isPositiveNet=false.
checkpoint_audit.conclusion: Checkpoint preserves the external system-library reference plus title/transform. It does not embed a new model geometry payload. This proves durable binding metadata, not self-contained model portability.

recommended_completion_path: Continue native qualified system-model instance links when appropriate, preserve the original system libraries unchanged, save/export the project and a STEP assembly with autoGenerateModels=false, and record that editable model references depend on the external system model library/cache. Retain separately obtained original STEP source assets as distinct evidence; do not claim those files are the system model source or embedded in the checkpoint.
